utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still waiting on Faye to spot the repair drive location, and I’ll let you know as soon as she does. Bo can start by the mailboxes, then check the side gate and that loose board by the walkway.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep the sign-up list ready and note those fixes by the mailboxes, side gate, and loose board. I’ll also remind folks they can bring repair requests to my porch or leave them on the community board.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Rosa — that should keep everything organized. I’ll pass along Faye’s update as soon as I have the repair drive location.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive. If folks need to request help, they can drop by Rosa’s porch or the community board.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Nell — I’ll pass that along too. Cleo’s already on the list and she’s bringing a few supplies, and Tess plans to come by.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks — I’ll keep passing it along. Rosa’s still the one collecting requests and sorting them by urgency, so I’ll point folks her way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I brought a few supplies for the repair drive, and Quinn saved me a spot. Oren’s helping sort the screws and check the tape, so we’re in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with tools and a steady pair of hands. Just point me where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — could you start by handing out tools and keeping an eye on the screw bins? That’ll help us stay organized.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I sorted the donated screws and checked the tape inventory for the repair drive. If you want, I can check the drive time and let Faye know right away so she can work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, but I still need the repair drive details first—date, time, and meeting spot. Once Jules confirms them, I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, sorry—I’m a bit scattered. I’ll wait for Jules to confirm the date, time, and meeting spot, then I can pass it along to Faye and the others.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks — once Oren sends the repair drive time, I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, it’s on Saturday. Mara said folks can bring small broken things and fix what they can there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, Saturday should be workable — I’ll keep the school schedule flexible once Oren confirms the time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got a few tools ready to lend for the repair drive. If anyone needs help, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus. I can bring a list of repairs later so we know where to start.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be great, Uli—bring the list by when you can, and I’ll match up the tools I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out running errands, and I’ll check for anything I can help with.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — can you let me know who still needs repairs? I can help spread the word and keep the list organized.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep — Eli said he’ll send me a clear list of what’s left, and I’ll pass it along as soon as I get it. I’m out running errands, so I’ll keep an ear out for anything else that needs a hand too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll make a clear list of what’s left for the repair drive and send it over to Ira. If Tess hears anything new, she can let me know and I’ll keep it tidy.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep spreading the word to the neighbors. Dane can start with donations and then help load the truck, and I’ll make sure everyone knows Nell’s still piecing things together.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik — that sounds orderly. I’ll get the list together and send it to Ira.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll sort the donated tools and set aside anything we can lend out, then I’ll label the boxes at Leo’s place this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That sounds great, Sam — thanks for handling it. I’ll keep listening for Quinn’s update and let Eli know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Tess — that’d help a lot. I’ll get the tools sorted this afternoon and keep an eye out for Quinn’s update too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help with the repair drive once I know the timing and pickup details are set. I’d also like to confirm what supplies we already have before I track down the missing ones and organize the list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you’re saying the repair drive timing and pickup details still need to be confirmed before you can move ahead?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, that’s right — once the timing and pickup details are confirmed, I can move ahead. I’d still like to check what supplies we already have first so I can fill in the missing pieces and sort the list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help with the repair drive this afternoon. Let me know if you need me to sort anything or load the truck.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Dane — I’ve got the sorting covered, and I’ll send the time and place soon. If you’re free later, loading the truck would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’m free later and can help load the truck. Just send me the time and place when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll send Noah the time and location for Saturday’s repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll bring gloves, a flashlight, and a few basic tools, and I’ll start by the mailboxes and work down the list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll text Noah the time and location now. Thanks for getting the gear together and starting by the mailboxes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll make a clear list of what’s left for the repair drive and send it to Ira. If Tess hears anything new, she can let me know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help this afternoon if you still need hands. Just point me to whatever’s left for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d help a lot, Dane. I’ll send you the list of what’s left, and we can get it sorted this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can work around the school schedule for the repair drive. If I spot the location, I’ll let Opal know right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks. Leo’s handling the time and place, and I’ll bring gloves, a flashlight, and a few basic tools so I can start by the mailboxes and work down the list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks — I’ll keep my schedule flexible and let Opal know if I spot the location. If Oren gets the time confirmed, I’m ready to work around it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll sort the rest and send the time and place for the repair drive. Sam can help with the donated tools and box labels at my place this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ve got a few tools ready to lend, so just let me know what you still need. I can bring them by when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — I’ll check what’s still missing and send you a quick list. Bring them by after I sort things this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll sort the donated tools and set aside anything we can lend out. Then I’ll label the boxes at Leo’s place this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s a huge help, Sam — thank you. I’ll keep the sign-up list updated and tell folks to bring any repair requests to my porch or the community board.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect — I’ll get started this afternoon and keep the lend-out tools separated. Thanks for updating the list, Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — could you send me the repair drive date, time, and meeting spot once they’re confirmed? I want to make sure I have the details before I help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I’ll send the date, time, and meeting spot as soon as they’re confirmed. I can also bring the repair list later so you have the full details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds good — please send the confirmed details when you have them, and I can help spread the word after that.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Cleo — thanks for being on the list and bringing a few supplies. I’m still spreading the word, and Tess plans to come too, so it should be a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Glad to help — I’ve got a few more supplies set aside if you need them. Sounds like the drive is shaping up nicely.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s fantastic, Cleo — thank you! I’ll keep passing it along, and we can definitely use the extra supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can check who still needs repairs and spread the word. What supplies do we already have on hand?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not sure yet — I’d like to confirm what we already have on hand first, then I can track down what’s missing and organize the list. Once we have the timing and pickup details from Kira, I can help line everything up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — I’ll check who still needs repairs and keep spreading the word. Let me know once you’ve confirmed the supplies and timing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’m out running errands, so I’ll keep an ear out for anything else that needs help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm — Pia will handle the timing and pickup details for the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes — Pia has the timing and pickup details, and I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and tell folks Dane can start with donations, then help load the truck. Nell’s still putting the pieces together, so I’ll keep it simple for now.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep connecting folks who want to help. Once Nell confirms the date, time, and meeting spot, I’ll send that to Hana.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll keep repeating the plan to neighbors and point them to Dane for donations first, then truck loading. Once Nell has the details, I’ll pass them along too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I sorted the donated screws and checked the tape inventory for the repair drive. I can check the time and let Faye know right away, since she can work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s great, Oren — thanks. I’ll keep an ear out for any updates, and Quinn said they’d share the repair drive details with me first, so I’ll pass anything new along to Eli.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess — I’ll check the repair drive time now and let Faye know right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll send Noah the time and location for Saturday’s repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with tools and hands on Saturday. If you want, I can also check in with Mina about who still needs repairs.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be great, Rey—please check in with Mina. I’ll send Noah the time and location for Saturday’s repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Nell—I’ll start by the mailboxes and then work through the side gate and that loose board by the walkway. If Faye spots the repair drive location, I’ll be ready to head over right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—I’ll spread the word, and I heard Rosa’s taking repair requests at her porch or the community board and sorting them by urgency.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, thanks, Nell. I’ll keep an eye out for Faye’s update and head straight over once the repair drive location is confirmed.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
